subject.title: perf: measure and reduce the shared route entry bundle

question: Should maintainers accept the documented route-contract extraction as a completed no-go and stop this investigation, or sponsor a different measured route-entry bundle-reduction hypothesis?
rationale: The submitted measurement rules out the proposed first extraction, but selecting a new architectural seam and a worthwhile reduction target is a product/performance tradeoff rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Accept the no-go
options.body: Treat the measured extraction as complete, retain its findings in the broader audit, and avoid further route-contract churn without new evidence.

options.title: Sponsor a new measured hypothesis
options.body: Name one different import boundary and a minimum closure reduction target, then require manifest and cold-navigation comparisons before expanding the refactor.

recommendation.title: Accept the no-go
recommendation.body: Treat the measured extraction as complete, retain its findings in the broader audit, and avoid further route-contract churn without new evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: They provided the measurement methodology and carried the related merged performance work, so they are the clearest available routing contact for a follow-up hypothesis.
